query_normalized: predicting bacterial antibiotic resistance from public genomic databases biology
rationale: The paper focuses on mathematical modeling of population dynamics and treatment strategies involving anti-virulence drugs, rather than the computational prediction of resistance phenotypes from genomic sequence data. It does not measure the same mechanism (genomic-to-phenotype prediction), use the same domain (public genomic databases), or provide a baseline for the specific task of resistance prediction, thus failing criteria (a) through (f).
